_about: The only list of approved n8n workflows (ruled 2026-09-10). A workflow exists in n8n only with a line here, and a line is written only after the Operator approved it in chat: name, group, one sentence why. n8n-push refuses to create a workflow that is not listed; n8n-pull places each workflow in its group folder and marks any unlisted workflow found in n8n as UNAPPROVED at the top of INDEX.md. Groups: rootflows (one folder per Rootflow, its rootflow.json beside its workflows), rootworks (the Hub machines, the lead handlers, the deploys and the syncs back), helpers (sub-workflows several of the above call), archive (retired, kept for reading, off in n8n).
